messages:
lina: Friday hybrid co-op night — mezz projector + remote stream. Who's in? Can anyone bring a PS5/PC, extra USB-C power adapters, and the projector remote? 

omar: I'm in. I can bring a DualSense + my dock and a 2m ethernet cable. 

jules: I'll be remote but can host the Steam Remote Play lobby (low-latency). @lina want me to run the lobby? steam://joinlobby/730/ABCDEFG 

maria: I can bring 2 power strips and a mini HDMI→HDMI adapter. Also have a Switch Pro I can lend if someone needs a controller. 

lina: amazing, thanks! last time the projector remote was under a beanbag :cry: can someone make sure we have it this time? 

omar: that was me who hid it last time, i'll bring the remote and snacks this round :thumbsup: 

jules: remote folks can jump in via Parsec too (lower overhead than screen-share). test connect string: `parsec://connect/room-xyz` if anyone wants a pre-run tonight. 

luca: quick poll — react with :one: for "bring PC", :two: for "remote-only", :three: for "drop in for snacks" so we know setup needs. 

maria: :one: — bringing a PC (and a spare USB-C adapter) 

event-bot: RSVP recorded: lina, omar, jules, maria, luca 

lina: final plan — meet 7:00pm in mezz; plug-check at 6:30. If you're remote, I'll post the lobby link 15 minutes before. Thanks y'all! 🍕
